known_outcome: In this specific application, it is the determination of the Board that fire blocking within the concealed space of the exterior wall located at the plane of the bottom of the dropped bulkhead is required in order to comply with Sentences 9.10.16.1.(1) and (3). Further the Board does not consider the application of using insulation permitted by Clause 9.10.16.2.(2)(d) to satisfy the requirements of Sentence 9.10.16.1.(1) and (3).
